name: Perfect Circle: Stand Alone
source:
Originally an additional story included at the end of Twofold, Perfect Circle is a story about love, connection and what we leave behind.

Perfect Circle: Stand Alone is an enhanced edition of this short story featuring:

-An additional scene
-Enhanced UI
-A brand new music track

[From the [url=https://2nd-draft.itch.io/perfect-circle]official website[/url]]
translation:
Perfect Circle最初是《Twofold》结尾处的一个附加故事，是一个关于爱、联系和我们留下的东西的故事。

《完美的圆：独立》是这个短篇小说的增强版，其中包括：

- 一个额外的场景
-增强的用户界面
-全新的音乐曲目

[摘自[url=https://2nd-draft.itch.io/perfect-circle]官网[/url]]
